# Mixamo character and animations

- Assets: `Character.fbx` (Mixamo character "Ch42", downloaded with skin) and the clips
  `Walk.fbx` (Walking), `Fall.fbx` (Falling), `Idle.fbx` (Breathing Idle), `Jog.fbx` (Running, also played faster as the sprint), `HardLanding.fbx` (Hard Landing), `Hang.fbx` (Hanging Idle),
  `ClimbUp.fbx` (Braced Hang To Crouch), `Jump.fbx` (Jumping, cut into
  JumpStart/JumpLand on import). Textures (`Textures/`) were extracted from the character FBX; clip files were stripped to the armature with Blender 5.1.
- Author/Source: Adobe Mixamo — https://www.mixamo.com
- Downloaded: 2026-10-22 from the team's Adobe account
- License: Mixamo terms — royalty-free use in games and projects; the raw files must not be
  redistributed on their own as an asset pack.
- Project use: playable character in the Fazenda level (humanoid rig, clips retargeted)
